items.title: Lawrence Trotter Interview, 1966-01-13
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] He sounds, a lot of times he sounds like Duke Ellendon to me. ... [INTERVIEWEE] So, that's right.

ctx.x: Did any of them sound much like Duke, like, or, or, or, or, or, or, or Basie or what?

Something similar. They arranged, uh, the arrangement would be, uh, sort of close to them. Whatever number that they would play, it seemed as though they would try to arrange it as close as they could to that particular thing.
